-# Check SETUP_COMPLETE (from file or env)
+# Load Keychain item presence for status checks without reading secret values.
+# Runtime credential resolution still happens in lib/env.py; this hook only
+# needs to avoid stale first-run/source-count messages.
+load_keychain_presence() {
+  case "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null)" in
+    Darwin*) ;;
+    *) return 0 ;;
+  esac
+  command -v security >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
+
+  local user key current
+  user="${USER:-}"
+  if [[ -z "$user" ]]; then
+    user="$(id -un 2>/dev/null || true)"
+  fi
+  [[ -n "$user" ]] || return 0
+
+  for key in SETUP_COMPLETE OPENAI_API_KEY SCRAPECREATORS_API_KEY AUTH_TOKEN CT0 XAI_API_KEY BSKY_HANDLE EXA_API_KEY; do
+    eval "current=\"\${ENV_${key}:-\${${key}:-}}\""
+    [[ -n "$current" ]] && continue
+    if security find-generic-password -a "$user" -s "last30days-${key}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+      printf -v "ENV_${key}" '%s' "keychain"
+    fi

Resolved in 3e36224: replaced the `eval` lookup in `load_keychain_presence()` with two-step Bash indirect expansion (`ENV_${key}` first, raw key fallback second), and documented the Keychain/pass credential layer plus effective priority order in `CONFIGURATION.md`.

Verified with `bash -n hooks/scripts/check-config.sh`, `git diff --check`, and `uv run pytest tests/test_check_config_ytdlp_detection.py tests/test_version_consistency.py tests/test_env_keychain.py tests/test_doc_flag_contract.py`.
